title: Salt Lake City declines to charge anti-child-trafficking activist with sexual assault
summary: District attorney cites ‘insufficient admissible evidence’ against Tim Ballard in connection with allegations A district attorney based in Salt Lake City is declining to file charges against the founder of an anti-child-trafficking organization – made famous by the 2023 movie Sound of Freedom – in the wake of sexual assault claims by several women in lawsuits. Sim Gill, the district attorney, issued a statement Friday saying there is “insufficient admissible evidence”, and his office has declined to file charges against Tim Ballard in connection with the allegations.
